roles.title: IT Service Delivery Intern II
roles.description: Working with the End User Support group and Cyber Security team on cross-functional projects. Authored a plan for implementing NIST 800-171 requirements in our environment, and contributing to the rollout of SAST, DAST, and AI/MCP security tooling. Built custom internal web assets in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and wrote PowerShell scripts to automate asset deployment. Responded to real world incidents and performed forensic analysis on devices involved in incidents.

roles.title: Resident Advisor
roles.description: Responsible for 20–40 residents depending on the year. Enforce housing policies, mediate conflicts, and serve as an on-call responder for two overnight shifts a week.

roles.title: Desktop Support Specialist
roles.description: Level-2 technician in the desktop support department. Assisted with the Windows 10 → 11 migration, imaged and deployed computers, and supported users across a diverse suite of software.

roles.title: IT Service Delivery Intern
roles.description: Worked with a team supporting applications and hardware in a diverse corporate environment. Assisted with Windows 10 → 11 rollouts, O365 application support, and asset management in Active Directory + Intune. Participated in cybersecurity trainings and simulations, and responded to real-world threats.

roles.title: Information Technology Assistant
roles.description: Worked in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. The on-staff Linux and Docker specialist — helped users set up and deploy Linux virtual machines for class and personal use, and troubleshot Windows and macOS issues ranging from network connectivity to hardware.

roles.title: Marketing Intern
roles.description: Worked with the marketing team on recorded and live video content.

roles.title: Information Technology Consultant
roles.description: IT consultant for a local driving school. Helped with the transition to Zoom, hardware upgrades, and web management.

roles.title: Junior Software Developer
roles.description: Assisted senior developers with refactoring, formatting, and debugging. Worked on a team to build a custom support system during a hackathon, and successfully deployed it to pre-production.

roles.title: Cashier & Busser
roles.description: Started as a busser and was promoted to cashier over the summer.
